passing_existing_cases: direct and naive item-unwrapped positive route

counterexample.label: STATIC_INSPECTION
counterexample.construction: object.item() returns exact built-in timezone-aware datetime or time
code_path: exact datetime/time is passed to normalize_decoder_physical_value
opaque_decoder_value raises R5CodecError because tzinfo is not None
_physical_value catches Exception broadly and suppresses that rejection
fallback _jsonable calls item() again and stringifies the timezone-aware datetime/time
counterexample.consequence: A timezone-aware decoder-native value can cross the physical decoder as an ordinary string instead of failing closed.
counterexample.violated_declared_boundary: D02 rejects timezone-aware values while supporting item()-unwrapped exact native date/time values.
counterexample.minimal_fix: Catch item() extraction failure only; let normalize_decoder_physical_value/opaque_decoder_value rejection propagate. Add item-wrapper timezone-aware hostile tests.

environment_hostile.behavior: At import time, if pandas is absent, test invokes python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check pandas.
environment_hostile.consequence: The semantic test mutates runtime capability and depends on mutable network/package-index state during collection.
